home.title: WheelWise: what does a new car really cost?

rankings.title: New car rankings: prices and cost of ownership | WheelWise

rankings.consumptionNote: This ranking shows litres per 100 km for combustion and hybrid cars. Plug-in hybrids are left out, because their consumption depends on how often you charge them. Electric cars appear in kWh per 100 km when “electric” is the only powertrain selected in the filters.
rankings.consumptionNoteElectric: This ranking shows the electricity use of electric cars in kWh per 100 km. To go back to litres per 100 km, change the “Powertrain” filter.
rankings.emptyText: Widen the price range or switch some filters off. The catalogue lists new cars only.
